comment: Gin 1.12 on Go 1.27, one function per family registering its routes in the implementation package under Implementation/, and the server's main package in container-h1. The suite is UnitTests/, go test over the router served by net/http/httptest, and never reaches the image. Gin writes nothing for a body it cannot bind, so a refusal is the answer gin's README gives: 400 and err.Error(). The validator names fields by their json names through go-playground's tag-name hook, which gin hands out through binding.Validator.Engine(). The first-error route is wired by hand, because go-playground cannot stop at the first failure. The lockfile is go.mod, which records every module version the build selects, and go.sum, which holds their hashes. upgrade is go get -u ./..., which moves every module to its newest release within its major version.

noHandler.cors.preflight: gin-contrib/cors on the /cors group answers the preflight, on an OPTIONS route that has no handler of its own.
noHandler.errors.unmatched: Gin's router answers a path no route matches with its own 404 and a text body.
noHandler.errors.wrong_method: Gin's router matches the method and the path together, so a method the path has no route for gets the same 404.

authorized.mechanism: A gin middleware on the route that compares the bearer token and aborts any other with 403

baseline.builtin: c.String writes the text as text/plain.

body.mechanism: Binding tags on the validate routes' order, which ShouldBindJSON hands to go-playground's validator once the body is decoded. The first-error route runs the same validator over one field at a time, because go-playground cannot stop at the first failure

cache.mechanism: A gin middleware in front of each cache route that replays a stored answer and otherwise stores what the handler wrote, keyed by the path and the route's vary headers, one store per process

compressed.mechanism: gin-contrib/gzip on the /compressed group, at its fastest level

cors.mechanism: gin-contrib/cors on the /cors group, with an OPTIONS route so a preflight reaches it

errors.builtin: Gin's router answers a miss, and a method a path lacks, with its own 404. A body the decoder cannot read is refused with 400 and the decoder's message, as gin's README answers a failed bind, and the items handlers abort a missing row with 404.

etag.mechanism: A gin middleware on the /etag group that holds back the body, hashes it with SHA-1 and answers a matching If-None-Match with 304

forms.builtin: ShouldBind picks gin's form or multipart binding from the Content-Type and fills the form tags, the file part as a *multipart.FileHeader.

headers.builtin: ShouldBindHeader fills the header tags, the account as an int.

items.builtin: One route per method on /items/:id, the id bound with ShouldBindUri. The read route names GET and HEAD, because gin answers HEAD only where a route names it.

json.builtin: c.JSON writes the payload with gin's JSON codec, which is encoding/json unless a build tag picks another.

middleware.mechanism: No-op gin.HandlerFunc layers ahead of the handler in the route's chain, four or sixteen of them

parameters.builtin: ShouldBindUri fills the uri tags, each capture as an int.

query.builtin: ShouldBindQuery fills the form tags, the numbers as ints.

sse.builtin: c.SSEvent renders each row as one event with gin's sse package, and c.Stream flushes it.

static.builtin: Static registers /static/*filepath and serves the payload directory through net/http's FileServer.

stream.builtin: c.Stream writes each row and its newline and flushes it.

template.mechanism: gin's HTML render over html/template, with the template embedded in the binary and loaded by LoadHTMLFS
